summary.text: John O'Brien is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-Orange-1 District, which he has represented since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He succeeded David Ainsworth in the seat and has been assigned to the Agriculture and Forestry Committee.
